# Frontend Design

Use this skill when building or reviewing React UI.

1. Pick one typographic scale and stick to it.
2. Keep dashboard cards on a consistent 8px grid.
3. Check color contrast for every text/background pair.

Verify the layout with the project's own test command:

```bash
npm test
```
